scorecardHelp.trailingYield: Trailing yield from the most recent disclosed gross per share. Uses end-of-day close when available; otherwise yield at the last ex-date. Not forward yield.
scorecardHelp.yoyDps: Year-over-year change in disclosed gross dividend per share vs the prior parsed calendar.
scorecardHelp.payoutRatio: Gross dividend per share divided by EPS from the matching fiscal-year SECNet annual report. Earnings-based — not free cash flow.
scorecardHelp.streak: Consecutive profit years with a parsed gross dividend per share, counting back from the latest without gaps.
scorecardHelp.coverage: Distinct profit years with a disclosed gross amount in our SECNet dataset. Coverage may not reach listing date.
scorecardHelp.yieldChange: Change in dividend yield at ex-date vs the prior parsed profit year (price and DPS both move).

dividends.marketsHeader: From SECNet · official calendars filed after shareholders assembly approval · not a forecast

statHelp.dayLow: Lowest price at which the share traded during the current session.
statHelp.dayHigh: Highest price at which the share traded during the current session.
statHelp.prevClose: Last closing price from the previous session — basis for today's change.
statHelp.volume: Total number of shares traded on the MSE in the current session (end-of-day).
statHelp.avgVolume: Average daily volume over the last 30 trading sessions.
statHelp.turnover: Total value of trades in denars (MKD) for the current session.
statHelp.avgPrice: Volume-weighted average price from today's trades.
statHelp.weekLow52: Lowest closing price over the past 52 weeks.
statHelp.weekHigh52: Highest closing price over the past 52 weeks.
statHelp.pe: Price-to-earnings ratio: share price divided by earnings per share (EPS) from the latest annual SECNet filing.
statHelp.eps: Earnings per share (EPS) — net profit divided by shares outstanding, from SECNet annual reports.
statHelp.earningsYield: Earnings yield: EPS divided by price, expressed as a percentage.
statHelp.dividendYield: Dividend yield: gross dividend per share divided by price, from the latest SECNet calendar.
statHelp.grossDps: Gross dividend per share (DPS) from the latest SECNet dividend calendar.
statHelp.payoutRatio: Payout ratio: share of net profit paid as dividends (gross DPS / EPS).
statHelp.exDate: Ex-date: last day to buy with dividend entitlement per the SECNet calendar.
statHelp.firstTrade: Date of the first trade in the share on the Macedonian Stock Exchange.
statHelp.fiscalYear: Fiscal year of the underlying financial data (SECNet).
statHelp.netProfit: Issuer net profit for the stated fiscal year (SECNet, thousands MKD).

fundamentals.epsHelp: Basic earnings per share from the latest SECNet audited annual report we parsed for this issuer.
fundamentals.netProfitHelp: Net profit for the fiscal year from the same SECNet annual filing.
fundamentals.peHelp: End-of-day close divided by disclosed EPS for the fiscal year shown. Not a live multiple.
fundamentals.earningsYieldHelp: EPS divided by end-of-day close (inverse of P/E). From SECNet EPS and EOD price only.
fundamentals.grossDpsHelp: Latest fully parsed gross dividend per share from a SECNet dividend calendar.
fundamentals.dividendYieldHelp: Last disclosed gross DPS divided by end-of-day close. Trailing, not forward yield.
fundamentals.payoutHelp: Gross DPS divided by EPS for the matching profit year. Both from SECNet filings.
fundamentals.empty: No parsed annual financials from SECNet for this issuer yet. Check Updates for filing links.
fundamentals.subtitle: Annual reports from SECNet · Data as of {date} · end-of-day close, not live
fundamentals.dataLine: Data as of {date} · end-of-day close, not live
